items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: There was a piano player there that you've probably heard of named Poison Gardner.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, we were all kids together, Jimmy Miller. And then we went to -- started playing in a club -- the Morrison Grenadiers went to Cleveland, we played in a place called the Cotton Club. And then my mother came and got me and made me come back to Columbus, Ohio. Then I came back -- now I'm talking about when I went there with Jeter-Pillars. There was a piano player there that you've probably heard of named Poison Gardner.
Yes. But I don't know anything about him.
